thin_warning: Genuine0.56mm grid webs,0.8mm half-step plates, cushion shells/skirts and handrail tangencies retain every sub0.8mm erosion warning. Crops test bounded regions, not global normal thickness or strength.
limitations: No strength, bridge-span, slicer, support-removal or physical-print certification. Seven actual lattice decks and major under-row air gaps remain; solid translucent cushions are not geometric air and STL cannot encode transparency. Curvature, display dimensions, grid density, ribs and sparse rail supports are approximated from2024 project photos, not a2026 survey.
